definitions.explanation: A clipped form of クレジットカード. It belongs to casual speech, chat, and online writing; formal documents, shop signage, and staff speaking to customers all use the full クレジットカード.

examples.japanese: その{店|みせ}はクレカが{使|つか}えないらしい。
examples.english: Apparently that shop doesn't take credit cards.

examples.japanese: クレカの{明細|めいさい}を{見|み}たら、{今月|こんげつ}は{使|つか}いすぎていた。
examples.english: When I looked at my credit card statement, I'd spent too much this month.

notes:
A clipping of クレジット + カード that keeps the front of each part, the same abbreviating pattern as スマホ (スマートフォン) and パソコン (パーソナルコンピューター).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クレカで{払|はら}う: to pay by credit card
- クレカが{使|つか}える: credit cards are accepted
- クレカを{作|つく}る: to get a credit card issued
- クレカ{払|ばら}い: payment by credit card

REGISTER:
Casual only. Say クレジットカード in a shop, on a form, or in any business setting; クレカ is for friends, family, and informal writing.
